object.name: evi.svf~
object.digest: Reimplementation of MSP <o>svf~</o> as a TPT filter
object.description: Linear TPT state variable filter with simultaneous outputs. The SVF is a really useful swiss-army-knife filter block. It is very efficient and using just a single outlet is an acceptable use case. The evieve SVF can have it's parameters dynamically modulated up to audio rate whilst remaining clean and alias free. The internal filter structure of <o>evi.svf~</o> is used in most of the other linear and nonlinear filters in the evieve package. Here it is presented in it's purest form to be as close to MSP <o>svf~</o> as possible. Note, here we use MSP-like ordering of outputs, but in all other evieve SVFs we use a different ordering.
object.discussion: For more information about other reimplementations of MSP filters in evieve, see the 'evieve: msp' tab of the helpfile.

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: The 2x oversampling is only useful for lowpass and bandpass outputs usage. It sort-of more closely matches the frequency response of the MSP Chamberlain SVF for those filter types.
